# Structural Learning

> > A comprehensive platform for UK schools providing AI-powered lesson planning, metacognitive thinking frameworks, and evidence-based teaching strategies grounded in cognitive science.

Structural Learning serves 400+ UK schools with tools designed to develop critical thinking and metacognitive skills. Founded by Paul Main, the platform combines classroom resources like Writer's Block with digital membership access to lesson planning, visual thinking tools, and professional development workshops.

## Key Topics

- Metacognition
- Critical Thinking
- Lesson Planning
- Cognitive Science
- Universal Thinking Framework
- Writer's Block
- Learning Skills Framework
- Evidence-Based Teaching
- Classroom Practice
- Teacher Toolkit
- AI-Powered Resources
- Hands-On Learning
- Oracy
- Visual Tools
- Rosenshine's Principles

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Membership Platform](https://www.structural-learning.com/membership): Lesson planning platform with thinking framework, graphic organisers, and AI-designed activities for building critical thinking skills
- [Thinking Skills Toolkit](https://www.structural-learning.com/landing-thinking-framework): 30 skill cards and AI lesson planning tool for developing metacognitive thinking across subjects
- [Writer's Block](https://www.structural-learning.com/block): Hands-on writing scaffold with AI activity matching to support structured writing instruction
- [Oracy Toolkit](https://www.structural-learning.com/landing-oracy): Tool for building confident speakers with AI-designed discussion prompts and speaking frameworks
- [Learning Skills Framework](https://www.structural-learning.com/learning-skills-framework): Comprehensive framework developing metacognitive skills and academic attributes for lifelong learners

## Teaching Resources & Tools

- [Visual Tools Guide](https://www.structural-learning.com/visual-tools): Graphic organisers including Fishbone and Diamond 9 diagrams for making student thinking visible
- [Classroom Shop](https://www.structural-learning.com/store): E-commerce store with Writer's Block kits and digital teaching resources for classroom use

## Professional Development

- [CPD Workshops](https://www.structural-learning.com/cpd): Professional development workshops on metacognition and cognitive science for teachers and school leaders
- [Research Newsletter](https://www.structural-learning.com/research-newsletter): Free education newsletter delivering latest cognitive science and teaching research roundups

## Educational Content

- [Education Blog](https://www.structural-learning.com/blog): 500+ research-backed articles on cognitive science, metacognition, and evidence-based classroom practice
- [Trauma-Informed Teaching Guide](https://www.structural-learning.com/post/trauma-informed-teaching-practical-guide): Practical guide to ACEs, trauma responses, and whole-school trauma-informed teaching strategies
- [Maths Pedagogy Guide](https://www.structural-learning.com/post/maths-pedagogy-evidence-based-approaches): Evidence-based maths teaching strategies and approaches for Key Stages 2-3
